checkedAlternates.risk: Fresh mozzarella is soft like Brie.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Fresh mozzarella is an unripened spun-curd cheese (group-1), lacking the Penicillium candidum bloomy rind of Brie and Camembert (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Roquefort uses mold ripening like Brie.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Blue cheeses are internally veined with Penicillium roqueforti (group-3), not surface-ripened with white mold (group-2).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
